last_sync.summary: Fuel-pump startup priming is now gated on the ignition being on. Previously the timed prime request could remain active after the ignition was switched off, holding the low-pressure pump on until the prime duration expired. With this change the prime stops on the next controller update after key-off, and each ignition-on transition starts a fresh prime interval. The recent-trigger hold and the forced-on bench request are unchanged, so Fuel pump off is still not an emergency fuel cut.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU now requires the ignition to be on for the timed startup prime, so the low-pressure pump no longer stays primed after key-off. Each ignition-on transition restarts the prime interval, and the prime still ends when the configured Prime duration expires. The recent-trigger hold and the forced-on bench request are unchanged, so a recent trigger can still run the pump with the ignition off, and Fuel pump off still only clears the manual request. No tune setting or migration is required; use a build that includes this change and do not assume older or differently branded binaries behave the same way.
evidence: firmware/controllers/modules/fuel_pump/fuel_pump.cpp: isPrime now requires ignitionOn in addition to the elapsed-time window against startUpFuelPumpDuration
